verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that BigCommerce offers REST and GraphQL APIs to manage products, orders, customers and store settings programmatically, so a user could in principle pull their data out as JSON through the API. Nothing documents a dedicated full-data export or exit path; the 'switch from Shopify, Magento…' messaging is about migrating in, not out. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or complete data export feature, export in open formats such as CSV or JSON, coverage of all data types including themes and content, offboarding or portability documentation, and independent confirmation that exports work.
